englishText: O Allah, verily I beseech You by Your Name:
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Ever-living! O Self-subsistent!

arabicText: يَا حَيُّ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انتَ
englishText: O Ever-Living! There is no god but You!

arabicText: يَا هُوَ يَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ
englishText: O He Whom none knows what He is,
nor how He is,
nor where He is,
nor in what respect He is, but He!
O Possessor of dominion and kingdom!
O Possessor of might and invincibility!

arabicText: يَا مَلِكُ يَا قُدُّوسُ يَا سَلاَمُ
englishText: O King! O All-holy! O Giver of peace!
O Granter of security! O All-preserver!

arabicText: يَا عَزِيزُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا مُتَكَبِّرُ
englishText: O Almighty! O All-compeller! O All-sublime!

arabicText: يَا خَاِلقُ يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ
englishText: O Creator! O Maker! O Shaper!
O grantor of Benefits! O Director!
O Severe (in punishing the evildoers)! O Originator!
O Returner! O Destroyer!

arabicText: يَا وَدُودُ يَا مَحْمُودُ يَا مَعْبُودُ
englishText: O All-loving! O All-praiseworthy! O All-worshipped!
O Far! O Nigh!

arabicText: يَا مُجِيبُ يَا رَقِيبُ يَا حَسِيبُ
englishText: O Responder! O Watcher! O Reckoner!
O Innovator! O Exalter!
O Inaccessible! O All-hearing!

arabicText: يَا عَلِيمُ يَا حَلِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
englishText: O All-knowing! O All-clement! O All-generous!
O All-wise! O Eternal!
O All-high! O All-tremendous!
O All-commiserating! O All-gracious!
O Condemner! O Recourse!
O All-majestic! O All-handsome!
O Guardian! O Surety!
O Annuller! O Bestower!
O All-noble! O Leader!
O Guide! O All-Apparent!
O First! O Last!
O Outward! O Inward!
O All-steadfast! O Everlasting!
O Knower! O Decider!
O Judge! O Just!
O Separator! O Joiner!
O Pure! O Purifier!
O All-powerful! O All-able!
O All-great! O All-sublime!

arabicText: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا احَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
englishText: O One! O Unique! O eternally Besought of all!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
englishText: O He Who begets not and was not begotten,
equal to Whom is none,
Who has no consort,
with Him is no aide
nor has He taken any adviser,
nor needs He any assistant,

arabicText: وَلاَ كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنَ إِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ
englishText: nor with Him is any god but He—
there is no god but You.

arabicText: فَتَعَالَيْتَ عَمَّا يَقُولُ ٱلظَّالِمُونَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
englishText: So exalted are You above what the evildoers say, a great exaltation!

arabicText: يَا عَلِيُّ يَا شَامِخُ يَا بَاِذخُ
englishText: O All-high! O All-lofty! O All-towering!

arabicText: يَا فَتَّاحُ يَا نَفَّاحُ يَا مُرْتَاحُ
englishText: O All-opener! O All-diffuser! O All-restful!

arabicText: يَا مُفَرِّجُ يَا نَاصِرُ يَا مُنْتَصِرُ
englishText: O Bestower of relief! O Helper! O Giver of victory!

arabicText: يَا مُدْرِكُ يَا مُهْلِكُ يَا مُنْتَقِمُ
englishText: O Comprehender! O Destroyer! O Avenger!
O Upraiser! O Inheritor!
O Seeker! O Vanquisher!
O He from Whom no fugitive can escape!

arabicText: يَا تَوَّابُ يَا اوَّابُ يَا وَهَّابُ
englishText: O All-relenting! O All-forbearing! O All-bestower!
O Originator of all means!
O Opener of all doors!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ حَيْثُ مَا دُعِي اجَابَ
englishText: O He Who answers wherever He is called upon!
O All-Pure! O All-thankful!
O Exempter! O Forgiver!
O Light of light!
O Director of all affairs!
O All-subtle! O All-aware!
O Protector! O Illuminator!

arabicText: يَا بَصِيرُ يَا ظَهِيرُ يَا كَبِيرُ
englishText: O All-seeing! O All-aiding! O All-great!
O Alone! O Solitary!

arabicText: يَا ابَدُ يَا سَنَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
englishText: O Eternity without end! O Support! O Everlasting Refuge!
O All-sufficient! O All-healing!
O All-fulfilling! O All-relieving!
O All-kind! O All-gracious!
O All-benevolent! O All-bountiful!
O All-beneficent! O All-solitary!
O He Who is exalted and dominates!
O He Who is master and exercises power!
O He Who is inward and aware!
O He Who is worshipped and thankful!
O He Who is disobeyed and forgives!
O He Who is not encompassed by thoughts,
nor perceived by vision,
and from Whom no trace remains hidden!
O Provider of mankind!
O Determiner of every lot!
O Lofty in place!
O Firm in supports!
O Transformer of times!
O Accepter of sacrifices!
O Lord of graciousness and benevolence!
O Lord of might and force!
O All-compassionate! O All-merciful!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ هُوَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ فِي شَانٍ
englishText: O He Who is every day upon some labor!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَشْغَلُهُ شَانٌ عَنْ شَانٍ
englishText: O He Who is not distracted from one labor by another!
O Tremendous in rank!
O He Who is in every place!
O He Who hears all sounds!
O He Who answers all supplications!
O He Who fulfils all entreaties!
O He Who provides all needs!
O He Who sends down blessings!
O He Who has mercy upon tears!
O He Who annuls slips!
O He Who removes troubles!
O He Who sponsors good things!
O He Who exalts in rank!
O He Who bestows requests!
O He Who gives life to the dead!
O He Who gathers all scattered things!
O He Who is aware of all intentions!
O He Who brings back what has passed away!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ لاَ تَشْتَبِهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلاصْوَاتُ
englishText: O He for Whom sounds are never indistinct!
O He Who never becomes annoyed at requests
nor covered by shadows!
O Light of the earth and the heavens!
O Ample in blessings!
O Repeller of adversities!
O Maker of the breaths of life!
O He Who gathers together the nations!
O Healer of illnesses!
O Creator of light and darkness!
O Lord of munificence and generosity!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَطَا عَرْشَهُ قَدَمٌ
englishText: O He upon Whose Throne no foot treads!
O Most Munificent of the most munificent!
O Most Generous of the most generous!
O Most Hearing of the hearers!
O Most Seeing of the viewers!
O Protector of those who seek protection!
O Sanctuary of the fearful!
O Asylum of the refugees!
O Patron of the believers!
O Helper of those who seek aid!
O Goal of the seekers!
O Companion of every stranger!
O Intimate of everyone alone!
O Refuge of every outcast!
O Shelter of every wanderer!
O Custodian of everyone astray!
O He Who is merciful to old men!
O He Who provides for small infants!
O He Who sets broken bones!
O He Who releases every prisoner!
O He Who enriches the miserable pauper!
O He Who safeguards the fearful seeker of protection!
O He Who governs and determines!

arabicText: يَا مَنِ ٱلْعَسِيرُ عَلَيْهِ سَهْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
englishText: O He for Whom the difficult is simple and easy!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَىٰ تَفْسِيرٍ
englishText: O He Who never needs an explanation!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
englishText: O He Who is powerful over everything!'

arabicText: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَبِيرٌ
englishText: O He Who is aware of everything!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ بَصِيرٌ
englishText: O He Who sees everything!
O Sender of the winds!
O Cleaver of the dawn!
O Dispatcher of the spirits!
O Lord of munificence and forbearance!
O He in Whose Hand is every key!
O He Who hears every sound!
O He Who takes precedence over everything that passes away!

arabicText: يَا مُحْيِي كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بَعْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ
englishText: O He Who gives life to every soul after death!
O my Provision in my hardship!
O my Maintainer in my exile!
O my Intimate in my lonesomeness!
O my Sponsor in my blessings!
O my haven when the ways make me weary,
when relatives give me up
and when every companion forsakes me!

arabicText: يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لاَ عِمَادَ لَهُ
englishText: O Backing of him who has no backing!

arabicText: يَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لاَ سَنَدَ لَهُ
englishText: O Support of him who has no support!

arabicText: يَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لاَ ذُخْرَ لَهُ
englishText: O Store of him who has no store!

arabicText: يَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لاَ حِرْزَ لَهُ
englishText: O Sanctuary of him who has no sanctuary!

arabicText: يَا كَهْفَ مَنْ لاَ كَهْفَ لَهُ
englishText: O Cave of him who has no cave!

arabicText: يَا كَنْزَ مَنْ لاَ كَنْزَ لَهُ
englishText: O Treasure of him who has no treasure!

arabicText: يَا رُكْنَ مَنْ لاَ رُكْنَ لَهُ
englishText: O castle of him who has no castle!

arabicText: يَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لاَ غِيَاثَ لَهُ
englishText: O Help of him who has no help!

arabicText: يَا جَارَ مَنْ لاَ جَارَ لَهُ
englishText: O backer of him who has no backer!
O my Adjacent Neighbor!
O my Sturdy Pillar!
O My God in truth!
O Lord of the Ancient House!
O All-affectionate! O Friend!
Deliver me from the chains of strictures,

arabicText: وَٱصْرِفْ عَنِّي كُلَّ هَمٍّ وَغَمٍّ وَضِيقٍ
englishText: turn away from me every care, grief and distress,
protect me from the evil of that which I cannot bear,
and help me in that which I am able to bear!
O He Who returned Joseph to Jacob!
O He Who removed the affliction of Job!
O He Who forgave the sin of David!

arabicText: يَا رَافِعَ عِيسَىٰ بْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَمُنجِيهِ مِنْ ايْدِي ٱلْيَهُودِ
englishText: O He Who caused Jesus, the son of Mary, to ascend and delivered him from the hands of the Jews!

arabicText: يَا مُجِيبَ نِدَاءِ يُونُسَ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَاتِ
englishText: O He Who answered Jonah's call in the darkness!
O He Who chose Moses by spoken words!
O He Who forgave Adam his slip
and raised Idris to a high place through his mercy!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ نُوحاً مِنَ ٱلغَرَقِ
englishText: O He Who saved Noah from drowning!
O He Who destroyed `ªd, the ancient,
and Thamud, and did not spare them,
and the people of Noah before;
certainly, they were most unjust and more rebellious,
and al-Mu'tafikah, He also overthrew.

arabicText: يَا مَنْ دَمَّرَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
englishText: O He Who destroyed the people of Lot
and crushed the people of Shu`ayb!
O He Who took Abraham for a friend!
O You Who took Moses for an object of His words,

arabicText: وَٱتَّخَذَ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ اجْمَعِينَ حَبِيباً
englishText: and took Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, for a beloved!
O He Who gave Luqman wisdom,
and bestowed upon Solomon a kingdom
such as may not befit anyone after him!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ نَصَرَ ذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ عَلىٰ ٱلْمُلُوكِ ٱلْجَبَابِرَةِ
englishText: O He Who gave Dhul-Qarnayn victory over the tyrannical kings!
O He Who gave al-Khadir (eternal) life

arabicText: وَرَدَّ لِيُوشَعَ بْنِ نُونٍ ٱلشَّمْسَ بَعْدَ غُرُوبِهَا
englishText: and returned the sun to Joshua, the son of Nun, after its setting!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ رَبَطَ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِ امِّ مُوسَىٰ
englishText: O He Who strengthened the heart of Moses' mother,
and guarded the virginity of Mary, the daughter of `Imran!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ حَصَّنَ يَحْيَىٰ بْنَ زَكَرِيَّا مِنَ ٱلذَّنْبِ
englishText: O He Who fortified John, the son of Zachariah, against sins
and calmed the anger of Moses!
O He Who gave Zachariah the good news of the birth of John!

arabicText: يَا مَنْ فَدَىٰ إِسْمَاعِيلَ مِنَ ٱلذَّبْحِ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
englishText: O He Who ransomed Ishmael from the sacrifice with a mighty sacrifice!
O He Who accepted the sacrifice of Abel
and placed a curse upon Cain!

arabicText: يَا هَازِمَ ٱلاحْزَابَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
englishText: O He Who routed the parties for Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household!
(please do) Bless Muhammad, the household of Muhammad,
all the messengers, Your archangels,
and all those who obey You!

arabicText: وَاسْالُكَ بِكُلِّ مَسْالَةٍ سَالَكَ بِهَا احَدٌ
englishText: I beseech You the supplication of every one who has besought you

arabicText: مِمَنْ رَضِيتَ عَنْهُ فَحَتَمْتَ لَهُ عَلىٰ ٱلإِجَابَةِ
englishText: and with whom You have been pleased and thus decided to grant his request.

arabicText: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
englishText: O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!

arabicText: يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
englishText: O All-merciful! O All-merciful! O All-merciful!

arabicText: يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ
englishText: O All-compassionate! O All-compassionate! O All-compassionate!
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Lord of majesty and honor!

arabicText: بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ
englishText: By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him!

arabicText: اسْالُكَ بِكُلِّ ٱسْمٍ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ
englishText: I beseech You by every Name with which You have named Yourself

arabicText: اوْ انْزَلْتَهُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ كُتُبِكَ
englishText: or which You have sent down in one of Your scriptures

arabicText: اوِ ٱسْتَاثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ٱلَّذِي عِنْدَكَ
englishText: or kept for Yourself in the knowledge of the Unseen with You,
by the junctures of might for Your Throne,
by the utmost limit of mercy from Your Book,

arabicText: وَبِمَا ﴿وَلَوْ انّ َمَا فِي ٱلارْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ اقْلاَمٌ
englishText: by the fact that, “though all the trees in the earth were pens

arabicText: وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ ابْحُرٍ
englishText: and the sea - seven seas after it to replenish it,
yet the words of Allah not be spent.
Allah is All-mighty, All-wise.”
And I beseech You by Your Most Excellent Names
that You have described in Your book thus saying,
“To Allah belong the Most Excellent Names, so call Him by them!”
And You said: “Call upon Me and I will answer you.”

arabicText: وَقُلْتَ: ﴿وَإِذَا سَالَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
englishText: And You said: “And when My servants ask you concerning Me, then surely I am very near;
I answer the prayer of the suppliant when he calls on Me.”

arabicText: وَقُلْتَ: ﴿قُلْ يَا عِبَادِي ٱلَّذِينَ اسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ انْفُسِهِمْ
englishText: And You said: “Say: O My servants who have been prodigal against yourselves;
do not despair of Allah's mercy.
Surely, Allah forgives all sins.
Surely, He is the All-forgiving, the All-compassionate.”
And I ask You, O my God,
I call You, O my Lord,
I please You, O my Master,

arabicText: وَاطْمَعُ فِي إِجَابَتِي يَا مَوْلايَ كَمَا وَعَدتَّنِي
englishText: and I desire for You to respond to me, O my Protector, just as You have promised me—
for I have called You just as You have commanded me.

arabicText: فَٱفْعَلْ بِي مَا انتَ اهْلُهُ يَا كَرِيمُ
englishText: So, do to me what is worthy of You, O All-generous!
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

arabicText: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ اجْمَعِينَ
englishText: May Allah bless Muhammad and his entire Household.

arabicText: ثم يمكنك أن تدعو الله القدير أن يستجيب لطلباتك الشخصية وسوف يستجيب لها بإذن الله.
englishText: Then you may pray Almighty Allah to grant you your personal requests and they will be granted, Allah willing.
